limitations: This is supplementary descriptive QA of the already retrieved metadata histories, not a replacement selection or a new photometric quality gate.
No source centroid uncertainty/flags or flux values used; offsets can reflect centroid noise, blends, misassociation or other processing. No origin is assigned.
One fixed Gaia counterpart per selected object is propagated; this supplemental check does not repeat the all-neighbor association decision for every source epoch.
Available history metadata need not be exhaustive and may span beyond the eventual main photometry window.
The original188-object selection, ordering and classifications remain unchanged.
